subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.**

Let the bully have (**a taste of his own medicine**).

options.text: A result that is still unclear and can go either way
When you are mistreated the same way you mistreat others
A visual presentation is far more descriptive than words

solution:
The correct answer is **"When you are mistreated the same way you mistreat others."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**a taste of his own medicine"** means to experience the same negative treatment that one has inflicted on others. (कठोर या अप्रिय व्यवहार जो किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा अन्य लोगों के साथ किए गए व्यवहार जैसा है)

 
 
• **Example**: *The movie is about a playboy who gets a **taste of his own medicine**__ when the girl he falls in love with jilts him for another guy.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is suggesting that the bully should be treated in the same way that he has treated others.
 
• This idiom is often used to convey a sense of justice or comeuppance.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
